name: Avnet, Inc.
summary: Avnet, Inc., engages in the distribution of electronic component technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. The company operates through two segments, Electronic Components and Farnell. It markets, sells, and distributes semiconductors; interconnect, passive, and electromechanical components; and other integrated and embedded components from electronic component manufacturers.
